reviews.comment: This would absolutely be the hardest class in Mays if Tristan wasn't a lenient grader. He is a great professor, has industry experience, and teaches difficult material very well. The quizzes are brutal, especially the second one. Tests are hard as well, but he really does a phenomenal job preparing you if you put the effort in. Highly recommend.

I took FINC 468 but there is no course code. This class was easily one of the hardest I've ever taken, but Tristan makes it worthwhile. He is an EXTREMELY generous grader and gives lots of extra credit. We will work with you if you're stuck and has helpful office hours. It is an interesting course and great prof so take it if u want a challenge.

I had him for FINC 468 but it won't let me select the course code. He is a great professor! He is really straight forward with what he wants. He is super accessible and is a fair grader. He will provide practice exams to study. I highly recommend it.

He's super great, and wants you to succeed. Everything is taught in lecture with minimal outside material. Case studies and exams were graded extremely fairly and if you put in effort you will do very well.
